a: Zero trust assumes no implicit trust based on network location.
Multiple layers of controls reduce single points of failure.
Threat modeling identifies what can go wrong and mitigations.
Secret managers store and rotate credentials centrally.
A WAF filters malicious web traffic before it hits the app.
DDoS overwhelms a service with traffic; mitigate with capacity and filtering.
Supply-chain attacks compromise dependencies or build systems.
An SBOM lists software components for vulnerability tracking.
Penetration tests simulate attacks to find weaknesses.
Incident response plans detect, contain, eradicate, and recover.
